primary: Feature-specific changes reach behavior without unexplained cross-feature changes; combine domain hypotheses with personal observations
personal_evidence: N0-N2 only, correct exact source span plus semantic review; domain hypotheses need not be individually observed
primary_checks: Destination-only change should affect relative attraction with defensible reasons; inspect unintended persistence or route changes
Persistence-only change should affect staying/moving behavior with defensible reasons; inspect unsupported destination or straightness claims
Explicit straight-versus-turning contrast should be reflected in route reasoning and relevant strategy; no numerical true probabilities assigned
Mobility/physical range input unchanged: inspect unsupported personal capacity claims; existing axis/radius code remains fixed
Do not require all other strategy probabilities numerically identical: normalized mixture is coupled. Inspect other-strategy ratios and stated basis.
Within-input repeat variability compared with between-input feature contrast; no significance claim from 2 repeats
replay: All numerically usable priors, semantically flagged outputs included as diagnostics; failed outputs retained in denominator, no autofill or model retry
adoption: No automatic winner or deployment. Compare case/seed-matched subsets if failures occur; disclose dropped matching rows.
limits: Same-author synthetic factorial pilot, not independent clinical holdout
Constant SAR reference from a related unknown-recent-behavior case, not same-input SAR generation
RAG frozen F06 block, no retrieval performance comparison
Feature prompt and output schema form one treatment package; individual field or token-length effects not isolated
Only location/persistence/route inputs manipulated; mobility feature is an unchanged-information check
Real cached OSM roads, hypothetical places, 1 hour, mind OFF; no true pause time or actual trajectory accuracy
constant_SAR_reference: F06_B_sar_0, frozen before new outputs, identical across all 24 requests
